items.title: Sudan civil war: Civilians used as 'human shields'
items.description: The situation in the besieged city of El Obeid in Sudan is worsening by the day, with rights organizations warning of mass atrocities. Children are traumatized and do not dare go to school.

items.description: Israel’s military said it detained over 70 suspects across the occupied West Bank overnight and on Saturday, a day after troops deployed across the territory following violence that left two Isrelisoldiers and four Palestinian villagers dead. items.title: Becoming the story: Injured journalists battle to leave Gaza for treatment
items.description: Gaza journalists injured or battling illness during the war are demanding urgent medical evacuation abroad.

items.title: Polish Drone Guides Ukrainian Strike on Russian Ammo Depot
items.description: A Polish-manufactured FlyEye reconnaissance drone was utilized by Ukraine’s 26th Separate Artillery Brigade to identify and destroy a Russian ammunition storage facility in the Bakhmut sector. items.title: Speaking Alongside Putin, Kazakh President Calls for Freeze of Ukraine War
items.description: The Kremlin later said that "freezing the conflict as such is impossible, given Kyiv's position."

items.title: Russian authorities try to recruit students to make up for soldiers shortages in drone regiments
items.description: As rumors of a new wave of conscription spread across social media, the Kremlin has ordered universities to provide 2% of their student body to support its war effort against Ukraine.

items.title: Zelenskyy Says Russia Wants To Bring More North Korean Troops Into Ukraine War
items.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that Moscow wants to bring in thousands of North Korean soldiers again for its invasion of Ukraine, with preparations in Russia having been under way since early summer.

items.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
items.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

items.title: Middle East: UN warns against wider escalation after Houthi attacks in the Red Sea
items.description: As fighting intensifies in the Middle East, the United Nations on Friday warned against further escalation in the US-Iran war and the risks to global shipping amid the fight over control of the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: How the Houthis blockade of the Red Sea could affect the global economy
items.description: NPR's A Martínez asks former U.S. deputy national security adviser Jon Finer what the blockade of the Red Sea by Houthi rebels means for the global economy.
